# Summer VAT Calculator — full content bundle

> Free UK Summer VAT relief calculator for the Great British Summer
> Savings, 25 June – 1 September 2026. Calculates the correct 5%
> summer price for children's dine-in meals, family cinema and theatre
> tickets, and attraction admissions, applying HMRC penny rounding
> (VATREC12030). Site: https://summervatcalculator.co.uk/.
> Publisher: Intelligenti Ltd, United Kingdom. Contact: support@intelligenti.com.

---

## What is the Great British Summer Savings VAT relief?

A temporary reduction of UK VAT from 20% to 5% on selected family-focused
supplies between **25 June 2026 and 1 September 2026** (inclusive). It is
intended to lower the cost of summer activities for households with
children. The relief is automatic at the till — it should be applied by
the seller at the point of sale, not claimed back later.

### What qualifies for 5%

- **Children's dine-in meals** — fixed-price kids menu deals, individual
  items on a children's menu, and non-alcoholic drinks included in a
  qualifying meal, when eaten on the premises.
- **Cinema and theatre tickets** — child tickets and family tickets
  sold as one package that includes at least one child admission.
- **Attraction admissions** — entry to theme parks, water parks, fairs,
  circuses, museums, zoos, aquariums and soft play centres.

### What stays at 20%

- Adult-menu food, including drinks not bundled with a qualifying
  child's meal.
- Takeaway and delivery (including children's-menu items consumed
  off-premises).
- Adult-only cinema or theatre tickets.
- Sports facilities, pay-per-ride charges, separate retail at
  attractions, parking, food sold separately at attractions.
- General retail goods and services not in the named categories.

---

## The maths — why "subtract 15%" is wrong

The rate drops by 15 percentage points (20% → 5%), but **that is not
15% off the price**. VAT is charged on the *net* price, not as a slice
of the total, so a flat 15% off the till price gives the wrong answer.

### Worked example — a £120 till price

1. **Strip the 20% VAT first.** £120 ÷ 1.20 = £100 (net).
2. **Add 5% VAT.** £100 × 1.05 = £105. Summer price **£105.00**.
3. **Saving.** £120 − £105 = **£15.00**.

The wrong shortcut (15% off): £120 × 0.85 = £102.00 — **too low by £3**.

### The correct one-step shortcut

Multiply the till price by **0.875** — i.e. take 12.5% off.

This is because:

```
1.05  ÷  1.20  =  0.875
(new gross multiplier) ÷ (old gross multiplier)
```

So `£120 × 0.875 = £105`. Same answer, one multiplication.

### Quick refund check

The customer saving is 15% of the *net* price (not the gross). On a
VAT-inclusive till price the quickest mental check is:

```
saving  ≈  price × 15 ÷ 120
£120 × 15 ÷ 120  =  £15  ✓
```

### HMRC penny rounding

All calculations on this site follow HMRC's rounding rule for VAT per
line item (notice VATREC12030): VAT is calculated on the net amount at
the appropriate rate and rounded to the nearest penny, half up. Net
and gross are derived consistently so totals match what a compliant
till would print.

---

## How to use the web calculator

The calculator at https://summervatcalculator.co.uk/#calculator accepts
three inputs:

1. **Amount** — the till price as displayed (with currency symbol).
2. **Basis** — choose "Includes VAT" if the price is gross, or
   "Excludes VAT" if it is net.
3. **Category** — one of: Children's dine-in meal, Cinema (child or
   family), Theatre (child or family), Attraction admission, or
   Other / not eligible.
4. **Date of supply** — defaults to 15 July 2026. If you pick a date
   outside the 25 June – 1 September 2026 window, the Summer 5% card
   shows the *hypothetical* 5% price struck through, with a note
   explaining the date is out of window.

It returns three cards:

- **Normal price** — the standard 20% price (net, VAT, gross).
- **Summer price** — the 5% price during the relief window (net, VAT,
  gross). Struck through with explanation when the date is outside the
  window or the category is not eligible.
- **Customer saving** — the £ saving and what percentage of the till
  price that represents, plus the "× 15 ÷ 120" quick-check formula.

---

## FAQ

### What is the Great British Summer Savings VAT relief?

A temporary reduction of UK VAT from 20% to 5% on selected family-focused
supplies between 25 June and 1 September 2026. It applies to children's
dine-in meals, child or family cinema and theatre tickets, and admissions
to attractions like theme parks, zoos and museums.

### Can I just subtract 15% from the till price?

No. The rate drops by 15 percentage points, but that is not 15% off the
price. The correct adjustment on a price that includes 20% VAT is to
multiply by 0.875 (12.5% off) — because 1.05 ÷ 1.20 = 0.875.

### Are takeaway meals included?

No. Only dine-in children's meals from the children's menu qualify.
Takeaway and delivery are excluded.

### Do adult cinema tickets qualify?

Only child tickets and family tickets sold as one package including at
least one child admission. Adult-only tickets stay at 20% VAT.

### Is this an official HMRC tool?

No. This is an independent calculator. Always confirm with current HMRC
notices and your accountant.

## The iOS app

A full-featured iPhone and iPad version of the calculator is available
on the App Store:

- **Name:** Summer VAT Calculator (App Store listing may show as
  "VAT Summer Saver" pending a rename).
- **App ID:** 6774140450
- **URL:** https://apps.apple.com/app/id6774140450
- **Requirements:** iOS 17 or later. English (UK).
- **Free** with a one-time **Business Unlock** in-app purchase that
  removes adverts and enables a business mode for adjusting
  back-office VAT records.

What the app adds beyond the web calculator:

- **Bundles** — calculate a family ticket as one composite line with
  per-component VAT splits.
- **History** — save calculations and revisit them; export as CSV.
- **Receipt scanning** — on-device only, using Apple's Vision
  framework. Images and recognised text never leave the device.
- **Business mode** — record back-office adjustments for sales made
  inside the relief window that were originally rung up at 20%.

## Privacy summary

- The iOS app stores everything locally on your device (SwiftData).
  Calculations, history, business adjustments and receipt scans never
  leave the device.
- The app shows banner adverts via Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) in the
  free version; Apple's App Tracking Transparency consent is honoured.
  Business Unlock removes ads.
- The website (summervatcalculator.co.uk) uses **GoatCounter**, a
  cookieless analytics service. IPs are hashed with a daily salt and
  discarded within a few hours. No personal data is stored. No cookie
  banner is required under UK PECR.
- Full Privacy Policy: https://summervatcalculator.co.uk/privacy/
